## Change summary
What changed, and why?

## Validation
- [ ] Relevant tests or checks run (include command or CI link).
- [ ] Existing behavior and compatibility considered.
- [ ] Terraform changes reviewed with `terraform fmt`, `validate` and mock-provider tests where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private cloud inventory or Terraform state committed.
- [ ] Any security findings or intentional exceptions documented.

## Rollback
Describe how to revert safely (especially for cloud configuration or workflow changes).
